facts.fact: September 1st（Present Day），Carson 把最后一箱牛奶装上 Pops 的卡车并砰地关上尾门，准备送奶。
facts.anchor: I loaded the last crate of milk into Pops’s truck and slammed the tailgate shut.

facts.fact: 出发前，Carson 在马厩陪 Blueberry 待了 nearly an hour，照例坐在她的隔栏角落里向她抱怨。
facts.anchor: Before leaving, I spent nearly an hour in the barn with Blueberry.

facts.fact: five years ago 的那场事故后 Carson 在医院和理疗中待了数月，Pops 则在 Georgia 找来最好的马医之一并竭尽全力救活了 Blueberry。
facts.anchor: Pops had tracked down one of the best equine vets in Georgia and done everything possible to save her.

facts.fact: Carson 花了 months 才让 Blueberry 允许她上鞍而不再恐惧地压低耳朵，两者都带着伤、需要重建信任。
facts.anchor: It took months before she let me climb into the saddle without pinning her ears back in fear.

facts.fact: Meme 与 Pops 相伴 more than forty years，而 Carson 只有 measly twenty-five；Meme 守寡时 Carson 学着维持 Marigold Ranch。
facts.anchor: Forty years was a lifetime compared to my measly twenty-five.

facts.fact: 镇上 at least three different people 会问 Meme 和 Carson 今年是否把 Harvest Festival 带回 Marigold Ranch，而答案已是 the last five years 的不。
facts.anchor: at least three different people would ask if Meme and I planned on bringing the Harvest Festival back to Marigold Ranch this year.

facts.fact: Walter Jones 是 Pops 最好的朋友，其儿子们经营 Jones Automotive；修车店离 Carson 约 two miles。
facts.anchor: Two miles. Jones Automotive was roughly two miles away.

facts.fact: Carson 尝试 A third time 启动 Pops 的卡车仍毫无反应，引擎彻底沉默，她不得不重新想办法。
facts.anchor: A third time, just to be sure I wasn’t giving up prematurely. And nothing. Absolutely nothing.
